name: fileflow-pathologize
description: Use when Go code moves, copies, renames, downloads, extracts, or generates files on disk — an EXDEV "invalid cross-device link" rename, a "file already exists" conflict, a destination path built from untrusted input (user data, scraped names, regex captures) — or when a filename or path segment must be safe on every OS. Not for plain `os` file I/O (use go), CLI file commands (use cobra-viper), or desktop file dialogs (use wails).
